findings.summary: Tessaline achieves higher BLEU than Varrow-NMT on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, with a statistically significant mean paired difference of 0.8 BLEU points (95% CI [0.2, 1.44], p=0.017, paired t-test over 8 seeds).
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, BLEU, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: The effect size is small (0.8 points) and the confidence interval is wide; significance is based on a single test set and one language pair.

findings.summary: Tessaline substantially outperforms the PhraseGrid baseline in BLEU on the same test set, with a statistically significant mean paired difference of 6.3 BLEU points (95% CI [5.87, 6.83], p<0.001, paired t-test over 8 seeds).
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, BLEU, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: PhraseGrid is a reference baseline, not the primary comparison; result is limited to this test set.

findings.summary: The BLEU advantage of Tessaline over Varrow-NMT is consistent with a small but statistically significant improvement, but the magnitude is modest relative to the gap over the phrase-based baseline.
findings.caveats: No direct statistical comparison between the two differences was performed; interpretation is qualitative.

drafts.passage: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieves a mean BLEU of 28.4 ± 0.6 over 8 seeds, compared to 27.6 ± 0.8 for Varrow-NMT, a statistically significant mean paired difference of 0.8 BLEU points (95% CI [0.2, 1.44], p = 0.017, paired t-test). Tessaline also substantially outperforms the PhraseGrid reference baseline, with a mean BLEU of 22.1 ± 0.8 and a statistically significant mean paired difference of 6.3 BLEU points (95% CI [5.87, 6.83], p < 0.001, paired t-test). The improvement over Varrow-NMT is small in magnitude relative to the gap over the phrase-based baseline, and these results are limited to this single test set and language pair.
